plan.title: Cross-Entity Event Visibility by RFX Search

steps.note: Create the event whose cross-entity visibility will be checked.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply a pricing template so the event can be configured.
Add the required line item for a publishable event.
Add the event participants required for publishing.
Publish the event so it has an RFX number and can be searched.
Confirm the event was created successfully before testing cross-entity visibility.

args.need: sign in as a buyer of another entity and search for this event's RFX number, then leave the buyer's events list showing the search result

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to an unspecified other-entity buyer or search by the event's RFX number in that separate session.
Verify the other entity's search shows no matching event.
